ayahOccurrences.text: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا تَغْلُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْحَقَّ ۚ إِنَّمَا ٱلْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُۥٓ أَلْقَىٰهَآ إِلَىٰ مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۖ وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ ثَلَٰثَةٌ ۚ ٱنتَهُوا۟ خَيْرًا لَّكُمْ ۚ إِنَّمَا ٱللَّهُ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُۥ وَلَدٌ ۘ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا

ayahOccurrences.text: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ مَغْلُولَةٌ ۚ غُلَّتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَلُعِنُوا۟ بِمَا قَالُوا۟ ۘ بَلْ يَدَاهُ مَبْسُوطَتَانِ يُنفِقُ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ ۚ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَٰنًا وَكُفْرًا ۚ وَأَلْقَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ كُلَّمَآ أَوْقَدُوا۟ نَارًا لِّلْحَرْبِ أَطْفَأَهَا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: لَقُوا۟ is in the derivative form: لَقِىَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ل/ق/ي   l–q–y to meet, to encounter, reunion
; to find; to undergo, to suffer, to experience; to throw, to cast; to give, to receive, to accept; to lie down.

Of this root, 16 forms occur 146 times in the Qur’an:
لَقِىَ laqiya 14 times; لَقَّى laqqā 1 time; تُلَقَّى tulaqqā 5 times; يُلاقُوا yulāqū 3 times; ألْقََىَ ʾalqā 58 times; أُلْقِىَ ʾulqiya 13 times; تَلَقَّى talaqqā 4 times; اِلْتَقَىَ ʾiltaqā 7 times; لاقِي lāqı 1 time; لِقَاء liqāʾ 24 times; تِلْقَاءَ tilqāʾ 3 times; تَلاقِي talāqı 1 time; مُلاقُو mulāqū 7 times; مُلْقُون mulqūn 3 times; مُلْقِيَات mulqiyāt 1 time and مُتَلَقِّيان mutalaqqiyān 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
لَقِىَ laqiya a [v. trans.]

1 to meet

(2:14) وَإِذَا‏ ‏لَقُوا‏ ‏الَّذِينَ‏ ‏ءَامَنُوا قَالُوا‏ ‏ءَامَنَّا ‏‏and when they meet the believers, they say, ‘We believe’

2 to meet in battle, to battle against

(8:45)‏لَقِيتُمْ‏ ‏فِئَةً‏ ‏فَاثْبُتُوا‏ ‏ ‏إِذَا‏ when you meet a force in battle, stand firm

3 to find

(17:13) وَنُخْرِجُ‏ ‏لَهُ يَوْمَ‏ ‏الْقِيَامَةِ‏ ‏كِتَابًا‏ يَلْقَاهُ‏ ‏مَنْشُورًا‏ and We shall bring out for him, on the Day of Resurrection, a record, which he will find spread wide open

4 to reap, to meet with, to come face to face with, to reap the result of one’s deed

(19:59)‏فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا الصَّلاَةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوَاتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا but there came after them successors who didn’t keep [lit. wasted] the prayer and followed [their] lusts–so they will meet with evil [for what they have done]

5 to experience

(18:62)‏‏لَقَدْ‏ ‏لَقِينَا‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏سَفَرِنَا‏ ‏هَذَا‏ ‏نَصَبًا we have experienced, in this journeying of ours‏, fatigue.

entries.label: ألْقَى
entries.definitionHtml:
ألْقَى ʾalqā [v. IV, trans.]

1 to cast down, to throw down

(26:32) فَأَلْقَى‏ ‏عَصَاهُ‏ ‏فَإِذَا‏ ‏هِيَ‏ ‏ثُعْبَانٌ مُبِينٌ‏ so he cast down his staff and–lo and behold!–it became a snake for everyone to see; *

(50:37) أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ listened in, lent an ear to [lit. cast the hearing]

2 to lay down

(16:15) وَأَلْقَى فِى ‏الأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ‏ ‏أَنْ تَمِيدَ‏ ‏‏بِكُمْ ‏and [He] set firm mountains on the earth, lest it sway under you

3 to bestow upon, to shower upon

(20:39) ‏وَأَلْقَيْتُ‏ ‏عَلَيْكَ‏ ‏مَحَبَّةً‏ ‏مِنِّي‏ and I bestowed upon you love from Me

4 to offer

(4:90) ‏فَإِنِ‏ ‏اعْتَزَلُوكُمْ‏ ‏فَلَمْ‏ ‏يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ‏ ‏وَأَلْقَوْا‏ ‏إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلَمَ‏ ‏so if they withdraw and do not fight you, and offer you peace; *

(75:15) أَلْقَى مَعَاذِيرَهُ toss out excuses

5 to lay on, to place on

(12:93) اذْهَبُوا بِقَمِيصِي‏ ‏هَذَا‏ ‏فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَى وَجْهِ‏ ‏أَبِي‏ ‏يَأْتِ‏ ‏بَصِيرًا ‏‏take this shirt of mine and lay it over the face of my father–he will become sighted

6 to hurl into, to cast into

(50:24) أَلْقِيَا‏ ‏فِي‏ ‏جَهَنَّمَ‏ ‏كُلّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ hurl every obstinate disbeliever into Hell

7 to instigate, to foment, to sow

(5:64)‏وَأَلْقَيْنَا‏ ‏بَيْنَهُمُ‏ ‏الْعَدَاوَةَ‏ ‏وَالْبَغْضَاءَ‏ ‏إِلَى‏ ‏يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ‏ ‏and We sowed enmity and hatred amongst them till the Day of Resurrection

8 to bring forth, to cast out

(84:3–4) وَإِذَا‏ ‏الأَرْضُ‏ ‏مُدَّتْ‏ وَأَلْقَتْ‏ ‏مَا‏ ‏فِيهَا‏ ‏وَتَخَلَّتْ when the earth is stretched out, and casts forth what is in it and empties itself

9 to charge with, to entrust with

(73:5) إِنَّا‏ ‏سَنُلْقِي‏ ‏عَلَيْكَ‏ ‏قَوْلاً ثَقِيلا‏ً We shall entrust you with a weighty discourse

10 to convey, to communicate

(4:171) إِنَّمَا‏ ‏الْمَسِيحُ‏ ‏عِيسَى‏ ‏ابْنُ‏ ‏مَرْيَمَ‏ ‏رَسُولُ‏ ‏اللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُ‏ ‏أَلْقَاهَا‏ ‏إِلَى ‏ ‏‏مَرْيَمَ the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, was only a messenger of God, and His word, [that] He conveyed to Mary ‏

11 to retort

(16:86)‏وَإِذَا رَأَى الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا شُرَكَاءَهُمْ قَالُوا رَبَّنَا هَؤُلاَءِ شُرَكَاؤُنَا الَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُوا مِنْ دُونِكَ فَأَلْقَوْا إِلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ when the idolaters see their partners [whom they ascribed to God] they will say, ‘Our Lord, these are the partners we used to invoke besides You,’ but the partners will retort, ‘Indeed, you are liars.’

entries.label: أُلْقِىَ
entries.definitionHtml:
أُلْقِىَ ʾulqiya [pass., v. IV.]

1 to be hurled, to be cast

(41:40)‏أَفَمَنْ‏ ‏يُلْقَى‏ ‏فى‏ ‏النَّارِ‏ ‏خَيْرٌ‏ is he who is hurled into the Fire better?

2 to be dropped, to be thrown over, to be delivered

(27:29)‏إِنِّي أُلْقِيَ‏ ‏إِلَيَّ‏ ‏كِتَابٌ‏ ‏كَرِيمٌ‏ a precious letter has been handed down to me

3 to be flung down, to be reduced to falling down

(26:46) فَأُلْقِيَ‏ ‏السَّحَرَةُ‏ ‏سَاجِدِينَ and the sorcerers were flung prostrate

4 to be revealed, to be sent down

(28:86) وَمَا‏ ‏كُنْتَ‏ ‏تَرْجُو‏ ‏أَنْ‏ ‏يُلْقَى إِلَيْكَ‏ ‏الْكِتَابُ‏ ‏إِلاَّ‏ ‏رَحْمَةً‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏رَبِّكَ‏ ‏‏you yourself could not have expected that the Book be revealed to you–[it came] only as a mercy from your Lord.

entries.label: اِلْتَقَى
entries.definitionHtml:
اِلْتَقَى ʾiltaqā [v. VIII, intrans.] to come face to face with one another, to meet one another

(8:44) وَإِذْ ‏‏يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ‏ ‏إِذِ‏ ‏الْتَقَيْتُمْ فِى ‏أَعْيُنِكُمْ‏ ‏قَلِيلا‏ and [remember] when He showed them to you, when you came face to face, as few in your eyes.

entries.label: تَلاقِي
entries.definitionHtml:
تَلاقِي talāqı [v. n./n.] encountering, encounter

(40:15)‏لِيُنْذِرَ‏ ‏يَوْمَ‏ ‏التَّلاَقِ‏ to warn of the Day of Encounter.

entries.label: تَلَقَّى
entries.definitionHtml:
تَلَقَّى talaqqā [v. V, trans.]

1 to receive

(2:37) فَتَلَقَّى‏ ‏ءَادَمُ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏رَبِّهِ‏ ‏كَلِمَاتٍ‏ then Adam received words from his Lord

2 to meet, to welcome

(21:103) ‏وَتَتَلَقَّاهُمُ‏ ‏الْمَلاَئِكَةُ‏ ‏هَذَا‏ ‏يَوْمُكُمُ‏ ‏الَّذِي‏ ‏كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ‏ ‏the angels will welcome them [saying,] ‘This is your Day, the one you were promised!’

entries.label: تُلَقَّىَ
entries.definitionHtml:
تُلَقَّىَ tulaqqā [pass. imperf. of v. لَقَّى laqqā]

1 to be made to receive, to be given

(27:6) لَدُنْ‏ ‏حَكِيمٍ‏ ‏عَلِيمٍ‏ وَإِنَّكَ‏ ‏لَتُلَقَّى‏ ‏الْقُرْءَانَ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ and you [Prophet] are given the Qur’an from One who is All‐Wise, All‐Knowing

2 to be granted

(41:35) وَمَا‏ ‏يُلَقَّاهَا‏ ‏إِلاَّ‏ ‏الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا‏‏ ‏وَمَا‏ ‏يُلَقَّاهَا‏ ‏إِلاَّ‏ ‏ذُو‏ ‏حَظٍّ‏ ‏عَظِيمٍ‏ but none will be granted it save for the steadfast; none will be granted it save for those endowed with great good fortune.

entries.label: تِلْقَاء
entries.definitionHtml:
تِلْقَاء tilqāʾ [v. n. used adverbially] towards

(7:47) وَإِذَا‏‏صُرِفَتْ‏ ‏أَبْصَارُهُمْ‏ ‏تِلْقَاءَ أَصْحَابِ‏ ‏النَّارِ‏‏ ‏‏and when their sights are directed towards the people of the Fire; *

(10:15) مِن تِلقَاءِ نَفْسِي of my own accord.

entries.label: لاقِي
entries.definitionHtml:
لاقِي lāqı [act. part.] one who finds something, one who meets with someone

(28:61) أَفَمَنْ وَعَدْنَاهُ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ لاَقِيهِ كَمَنْ مَتَّعْنَاهُ مَتَاعَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ‏ ‏is the one to whom We have made a good promise, then he finds it [coming true], like the one We have given some worldly enjoyment but on the Day of Resurrection will be one of those taken to task?

entries.label: لَقَّى
entries.definitionHtml:
لَقَّى laqqā [v. II, doubly trans.] to reward, to give

(76:11) فَوَقَاهُمُ‏ ‏اللَّهُ‏ ‏شَرَّ‏ ‏ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ‏‏ ‏وَلَقَّاهُمْ‏ ‏نَضْرَةً‏ ‏وَسُرُورًا‏ so God protected them from the evil of that Day, and rewarded them with radiance and gladness.

entries.label: لِقَاء
entries.definitionHtml:
لِقَاء liqāʾ [v. n.] meeting, to meet

(18:110) ‏فَمَنْ‏ ‏كَانَ‏ ‏يَرْجُوا‏ ‏لِقَاءَ‏ ‏رَبِّهِ‏ so whoever hopes of meeting his Lord.

entries.label: مُتَلَقِّي
entries.definitionHtml:
مُتَلَقِّي mutalaqqı [act. part.] one receiving, receiver, receptor, recording angel

(50:17) إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ when the two receivers receive [him], one seated on the left [and the other] on the right.

entries.label: مُلاقِى
entries.definitionHtml:
مُلاقِى mulāqı [act. part.] one who meets, meets with

(2:46) الَّذِينَ‏ ‏يَظُنُّونَ‏ أَنَّهُمْ مُلاَقُو رَبِّهِم‏‏ those who believe [also interpreted as: who expect] that they will meet their Lord.

entries.label: مُلْقِي
entries.definitionHtml:
مُلْقِي mulqı [act. part.; fem. pl. مُلْقِيَات mulqiyāt]

1 one who casts or throws something down

(7:115) وَإِمَّا‏ ‏أَنْ‏ ‏نَكُونَ‏ ‏نَحْنُ‏ ‏الْمُلْقِينَ قَالُوا‏ ‏يَامُوسَى‏ ‏إِمَّا‏ ‏أَنْ‏ ‏تُلْقِيَ‏ ‏so they said, ‘Moses, either you throw first or we will be the ones to throw’

2 one who brings down, one who delivers

(77:5–6) فَالْمُلْقِيَاتِ‏ ‏ذِكْرًا عُذْرًا‏ ‏أَوْ‏ ‏نُذْرًا‏ and those delivering a message that excuses or warns!

entries.label: يُلاقِي
entries.definitionHtml:
يُلاقِي yulāqı [imperf. of v. III, trans.] to meet with, to encounter, to come face to face with

(70:42) فَذَرْهُمْ‏ ‏يَخُوضُوا‏ ‏وَيَلْعَبُوا‏ ‏حَتَّى يُلاَقُوا‏ ‏يَوْمَهُمُ‏ ‏الَّذِي‏ ‏يُوعَدُونَ‏ so leave them to wallow in idle talk and jest, until they come face to face with their promised Day.
